captionEffects.title: Caption Text Effects in ByteWave
captionEffects.description: Choose a caption text effect in ByteWave, preview its animation and compare Orbital Letters, Supernova and Ember Ash.
captionEffects.lead: Try an effect on your own words. Preview it over your footage before exporting.
captionEffects.step1: Select a caption in your ByteWave project.
captionEffects.step2: Open its text effects and choose a preset.
captionEffects.step3: Play your video to see the effect in motion.
captionEffects.tip: Try the same short phrase with each effect. Adjust the font, size, and color to suit your footage.

customFonts.title: Your Fonts Shouldn’t Need a Subscription.
customFonts.description: Import your own TTF or OTF fonts into ByteWave on iPhone. Choose a file and use My Fonts to style captions for free.
customFonts.lead: Bring your own font to your video. ByteWave’s font import is free.
customFonts.step1: Save a TrueType (.ttf) or OpenType (.otf) font in the Files app. Extract any ZIP archive first.
customFonts.step2: Select a caption in your ByteWave project and open its Font panel.
customFonts.step3: Tap Import font and choose the file.
customFonts.step4: Find it under My Fonts. Tap the font to apply it to your caption.
customFonts.preview: Play the video to check your text, adjust its size and color, then export.
customFonts.unsupported: Choose the actual .ttf or .otf file. Web fonts such as .woff and .woff2 are not supported by this importer.
customFonts.license: ByteWave does not charge for importing fonts. The font itself may have its own price and license; check the creator’s terms for your use.
